instruction: You are at the new Launch Site on Planet X. To better monitor the weather patterns, you were tasked to send a new probe on orbit at 9616 kilometers from the ground. You were told to simply punch in the target orbital speed needed for such an altitude in the launch terminal and the system will take care of the rest. There is only one single-stage rocket, and this is a very important mission, so we better get it right the first time!
